description: The user seeks to discover patterns, generate hypotheses, or broadly explore a topic without predefined expectations. Often open-ended and inductive.
The user intends to compare two or more methods, approaches, datasets, tools, methods, or hypotheses to evaluate differences or effectiveness.
The user wants a concise, factual explanation or summary of a concept, object, or phenomenon—often 'What is X?'.
The user asks about causes, effects, or mechanisms—typically beginning with 'Why' or 'How does X influence Y?'.
The user inquires about the relationship or correlation between two or more scientific variables or phenomena.
